newsitem.title: USA: Atmel stock falls on profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Atmel stock falls on profit warning.

text.p: The stock of Atmel Corp. lost 15 percent of its value Friday after the semiconductor maker said its first quarter earnings would fall short of Wall Street's expectations because of its inability to deliver new products quickly to market.
San Jose, Calif.-based Atmel was off $5 at $26.50 in heavy trading of more than 12.6 million shares on the Nasdaq.
The company said its first-quarter profits would fall short of earlier expectations, with revenues off as much as 10 percent from the $281.1 million reported in the fourth quarter.

Analysts had estimated Atmel's earnings would hover at the 53 cents per share that it posted in the fourth quarter on net income of $53.6 million. In the first quarter of last year, Atmel earned 45 cents a share, or $44.9 million.
"We were not able to deliver new products fast enough and complete the customer qualifications to enable us to meet our revenue goals," Atmel said in a statement.
